findings.reason: it adds a write path and a done-when case that the builder must have, or the lift silently fails on the default routing path while the node's own tests stay green.
findings.text: the deliverable says "A project lift covers every dispatch whose project matches" and threads the project into `_budget_verdict`/`_config_with_effective_budget` (routing.py), `effective_block` (budget_group.py) and `effective_budget`/`_governing_lift`/`_applies` (budget_lift.py), but the picker reads the same `effective_block` at `reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py:1113` (`_effective_budget_block`, called from `_budget_exclusion_reasons` at :1165 with `session=` but no project), and that reader commits in its own docstring to judging "the same block a dispatch of this purpose takes … the picker refuses a lane a dispatch would refuse". Threading the project only through the dispatch chain leaves the picker blind to a project lift, so for a picker-routed dispatch of project A — the default, since `--local`/`--backend` are not named — the lifted lane stays withheld by `budget-ceiling` while `crew dispatch`'s own verdict would admit it; the plan's write paths do not include `reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py` and no done-when case covers the picker.

findings.reason: the storage multiplicity decides the clear and list semantics a builder must implement, and the plan asserts a singular "lift naming two projects" that its own single-name clear and list bullets contradict.
findings.text: the deliverable makes `--for-project` "repeatable for several projects" and a done-when case asserts "a lift naming two projects covers both" (one lift, two projects), but the revocation and listing cases apply only to a single-project lift: `--lift --clear --for-project A` "revokes it" and `--list` "shows the scope `project:A`". Nothing states whether a two-project grant is one record whose scope is a set (`project:A,B`, so clearing A is undefined) or two records (`project:A` and `project:B`), so `_scope` (budget_lift.py:1355), `clear` (:500) and the pane row (`lift_watch._scope_session`, :381) can be built against incompatible representations and the multi-project clear/list behaviour is untested.
